generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all active medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans in the current plan year.
generic.In-scope period: Annual benchmarking cycle run each Q1 ahead of renewal decisions.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan name, tier, employee premium share, and percentile rank populated for every plan.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Plan count on the benchmarking summary tab matches the current plan matrix count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Benchmark workbook saved to SharePoint with a version date and analyst name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Plans outside the 10th-90th percentile band logged with a stated cause.
generic.Test population: Sample every plan flagged outside the 10th-90th percentile band.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when a percentile rank is recorded for 100% of plans in the matrix.
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-band plans route to the Compensation & Benefits Manager for redesign review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Benchmark workbook accepted when every plan has a recorded percentile rank.
generic.Evidence location: Benefits Strategy deliverable record and workspace in SharePoint.

steps.title: Pull the current plan matrix from the Benefits Strategy workspace in HRIS
sop: Open the Benefits Strategy workspace in HRIS (Workday/SuccessFactors).
Export the medical, dental, vision, life, and disability rate matrix for the current plan year.
Confirm every active plan option is included in the export.
Done when the plan matrix export is saved to the market comparison workbook.
verify: Compare the exported plan count to the active plan list in HRIS.
Pass when every active plan appears in the exported matrix.

steps.title: Import the Mercer/WTW survey cut into the market comparison workbook in SharePoint
sop: Open the market comparison workbook in SharePoint.
Import the current-year Mercer/WTW national benchmark survey cut.
Align survey plan categories to the internal plan matrix rows.
Done when the survey data is mapped to each internal plan row.
verify: Spot-check three plan rows against the raw survey file.
Pass when mapped values match the source survey exactly.

steps.title: Flag plans with premium share outside the 10th-90th percentile band
sop: Calculate each plan's percentile rank against the survey distribution.
Flag any plan whose employee premium share falls outside the 10th-90th percentile.
Record the percentile rank on the benchmarking summary tab.
Done when every plan shows a percentile rank and flag status.
verify: Recompute the percentile for two flagged plans manually.
Pass when the recorded flag matches the recomputed percentile band.

steps.title: Record percentile rank per plan on the benchmarking summary tab
sop: Open the benchmarking summary tab in the workbook.
Enter the percentile rank for each plan from the calculation step.
Confirm no plan row is left blank.
Done when every plan row shows a percentile rank.
verify: Count summary tab rows against the plan matrix row count.
Pass when the counts match with no missing rank.

steps.title: Attach the completed benchmark workbook to the Benefits Strategy deliverable record
sop: Open the Benefits Strategy deliverable record in SharePoint.
Upload the finalized benchmark workbook with a version date in the file name.
Confirm the Compensation & Benefits Manager has view access to the record.
Done when the workbook is attached and access is confirmed.
verify: Open the deliverable record and confirm the attachment opens correctly.
Pass when the attached workbook matches the finalized version.

steps.title: Review the benchmark results with the Compensation & Benefits Manager
sop: Walk through the flagged plans and percentile ranks with the analyst.
Confirm the flagged plans warrant inclusion in the strategy review.
Note any plan requiring further market data.
Done when the reviewed benchmark is approved for the strategy review.
verify: Confirm sign-off is recorded on the benchmarking summary tab.
Pass when the Compensation & Benefits Manager sign-off is dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every contracted medical, dental, vision, and life carrier for the new plan year.
generic.In-scope period: Annual renewal collection window preceding the new plan year effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Effective date, rate guarantee period, and tier rates populated for each carrier exhibit.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Renewal tracker row count matches the contracted carrier count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed renewal exhibits filed in SharePoint with the receipt date noted.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Carriers not yet returning an exhibit logged with a follow-up date.
generic.Test population: Sample every contracted carrier's renewal exhibit.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when 100% of contracted carriers show a received renewal rate exhibit.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing exhibits escalate to the carrier's account manager for resubmission.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Renewal tracker accepted when every carrier row shows a received exhibit.
generic.Evidence location: Carrier Renewals folder in SharePoint and the renewal tracker.

steps.title: Confirm the contracted carrier list is current before the renewal collection cycle
sop: Pull the current contracted carrier list from the vendor contract tracker.
Confirm no carrier has terminated or changed account manager contacts.
Update account manager contact details where needed.
Done when the contracted carrier list and contacts are confirmed current.
verify: Compare the pulled list to the vendor contract tracker.
Pass when the list matches the tracker with current contacts.

steps.title: Send the annual renewal letter requesting rate exhibits to each carrier account manager
sop: Draft the annual renewal request letter for each contracted carrier.
Send the letter to each carrier's account manager via email.
Confirm the requested tier breakout (EE, EE+spouse, EE+child, family) is specified.
Done when a renewal request has been sent to every contracted carrier.
verify: Check the sent-items log against the contracted carrier list.
Pass when a request was sent to every contracted carrier.

steps.title: Log received rates by coverage tier on the renewal tracker in SharePoint
sop: Open the renewal tracker in SharePoint.
Enter the EE, EE+spouse, EE+child, and family rate for each received exhibit.
Mark the carrier row as received with the receipt date.
Done when every received exhibit's rates are logged by tier.
verify: Compare tracker entries to the source exhibit for two carriers.
Pass when logged tier rates match the source exhibit exactly.

steps.title: Confirm effective date, rate guarantee period, and design changes on each exhibit
sop: Review each renewal exhibit for effective date and guarantee period.
Confirm any plan-design change is called out explicitly.
Flag any exhibit missing a required element back to the carrier.
Done when every exhibit is confirmed complete or flagged for correction.
verify: Review the confirmation notes against the exhibit checklist.
Pass when every exhibit is marked complete or has an open correction flag.

steps.title: File each signed renewal exhibit in the Carrier Renewals folder in SharePoint
sop: Collect the signed version of each carrier's renewal exhibit.
Upload each exhibit to the Carrier Renewals folder in SharePoint.
Name each file with carrier name and plan year.
Done when every signed exhibit is filed in the folder.
verify: Open the folder and count filed exhibits against the contracted carrier count.
Pass when a filed exhibit exists for every contracted carrier.

steps.title: Confirm all contracted carriers show a received exhibit on the renewal tracker
sop: Review the renewal tracker for any carrier still marked not received.
Escalate any outstanding carrier to its account manager.
Confirm the tracker is complete before the strategy review.
Done when every carrier row shows received status.
verify: Review the final tracker status column.
Pass when no carrier row remains marked not received.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is medical, dental, and vision plans reviewed over the trailing three plan years.
generic.In-scope period: Annual strategy review cycle covering the prior three plan years of cost and utilization data.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Loss ratio, utilization trend, and benchmark position populated for each plan.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Plan count in the review deck matches the active plan matrix.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Review deck saved to the Benefits Strategy deliverable with version and date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Plans with rising loss ratios logged with a redesign option considered.
generic.Test population: Sample every plan included in the three-year loss ratio review.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the deck is signed off with a documented recommendation.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved redesign questions route to the next leadership review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Deck accepted when recommendation and rationale are recorded and signed.
generic.Evidence location: Benefits Strategy deliverable record in SharePoint.

steps.title: Schedule the annual benefits strategy review meeting
sop: Set the review meeting date ahead of the renewal decision deadline.
Invite the Benefits Administrator and HR Business Partner.
Confirm the required cost-trend and benchmark inputs will be ready.
Done when the review meeting is scheduled with required inputs confirmed.
verify: Check the calendar invite for confirmed attendee acceptance.
Pass when all required attendees have accepted the invite.

steps.title: Compile the cost-trend, utilization, and benchmark packet in Power BI
sop: Pull cost-trend and utilization data from the Power BI Benefits Cost dashboard.
Pull the current benchmark position from the completed benchmarking workbook.
Assemble the packet into the annual strategy review deck template.
Done when the packet is assembled in the review deck.
verify: Spot-check three data points in the packet against the source dashboard.
Pass when spot-checked figures match the source dashboard.

steps.title: Review medical, dental, and vision loss ratios against the prior three plan years in HRIS
sop: Pull loss ratio history for medical, dental, and vision from HRIS.
Compare the current year loss ratio to the prior three plan years.
Note any plan with a rising or above-target loss ratio.
Done when the three-year loss ratio comparison is documented in the deck.
verify: Recheck one flagged plan's loss ratio trend against the HRIS history.
Pass when the recorded trend matches the HRIS history.

steps.title: Document redesign options considered in the strategy review deck
sop: List each redesign option considered: plan tiers, cost-share shifts, new voluntary lines.
Note the estimated cost impact of each option.
Attach the redesign option list to the strategy review deck.
Done when every considered option is documented with cost impact.
verify: Confirm each documented option has a stated cost impact.
Pass when no option is missing a cost impact figure.

steps.title: Record the final strategy recommendation and rationale in the Benefits Strategy deliverable
sop: Select the final recommended strategy from the documented options.
Write the rationale referencing the loss ratio trend and benchmark position.
Save the recommendation to the Benefits Strategy deliverable record.
Done when the recommendation and rationale are recorded in the deliverable.
verify: Read the recorded rationale against the supporting loss ratio and benchmark data.
Pass when the rationale is directly supported by the cited data.

steps.title: Obtain sign-off on the strategy review deck
sop: Circulate the finalized deck to the Benefits Administrator and HR Business Partner for review.
Incorporate any final comments before closing the review.
Sign and date the completed deck.
Done when the deck carries a dated sign-off.
verify: Open the deck and confirm the sign-off is present and dated.
Pass when the sign-off is present with a valid date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every approved plan option configured for the new plan year in Workday HCM.
generic.In-scope period: Pre-enrollment configuration window ending at the enrollment build deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Plan tier, rate, effective date, and eligibility rule populated for each plan option.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Configured plan count matches the approved plan design count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation report and sign-off saved with the configuration date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Configuration validation errors logged with the correction applied.
generic.Test population: Sample every plan option moved from test tenant to production.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the validation report shows zero open errors.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved validation errors block production migration until corrected.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Configuration accepted when rates match the signed renewal exhibit line-by-line.
generic.Evidence location: Benefits configuration validation report in Workday HCM.

steps.title: Confirm the approved plan design and rate package is finalized before configuration begins
sop: Retrieve the signed plan design and contribution rate approval.
Confirm the approval package lists every plan option to configure.
Notify HR Specialist and Payroll Specialist that configuration is starting.
Done when the approved package is confirmed complete and configuration is kicked off.
verify: Check the approval package against the plan option list.
Pass when every plan option to configure has an approved entry.

steps.title: Enter approved plan tiers, rates, and effective dates in Workday HCM Plan Configuration
sop: Open Benefits > Plan Configuration in Workday HCM.
Enter the tier structure, rate, and effective date for each approved plan option.
Save each plan configuration record.
Done when every approved plan option is entered in Plan Configuration.
verify: Compare entered rates to the plan design approval document.
Pass when every entered rate matches the approval document.

steps.title: Configure eligibility rules for waiting period and employee class per plan
sop: Open the eligibility rule section for each plan option.
Set the waiting period and eligible employee class per plan.
Confirm rules align with the plan document requirements.
Done when eligibility rules are configured for every plan option.
verify: Test the rule against one employee class scenario per plan.
Pass when each tested scenario resolves to the correct eligibility outcome.

steps.title: Run the benefits configuration validation report in Workday HCM
sop: Run the configuration validation report against the test tenant.
Review each reported error and its source field.
Correct configuration errors and rerun the report.
Done when the validation report returns zero open errors.
verify: Open the final validation report output.
Pass when the report shows zero open errors.

steps.title: Confirm configured rates match the signed carrier renewal exhibit line-by-line
sop: Open the signed carrier renewal exhibit for each plan.
Compare each configured rate line-by-line to the exhibit.
Correct any mismatch found in Plan Configuration.
Done when every configured rate matches the signed exhibit.
verify: Re-check three plan rates against the exhibit after correction.
Pass when all checked rates match the signed exhibit.

steps.title: Move the configuration from test tenant to production in Workday HCM
sop: Confirm the validation report and rate match checks are complete.
Migrate the configuration from the test tenant to production.
Confirm the migration completes before the enrollment build deadline.
Done when the production tenant reflects the approved configuration.
verify: Spot-check plan options in the production tenant against the test tenant.
Pass when production matches the validated test configuration.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all candidate program options: medical, dental, vision, life, disability, EAP, FSA/HSA.
generic.In-scope period: Annual program evaluation cycle ahead of the plan year design decision.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Score, budget impact, and employee-needs rating populated for each option.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scored option count matches the full candidate option list.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring workbook saved with evaluation date and analyst name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Options creating disparate officer/non-officer tiers logged with the resolution.
generic.Test population: Sample every candidate program option scored.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every candidate option has a recorded score and cost impact.
generic.Exception handling path: Disparate-tier findings route to the Compensation & Benefits Manager for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Evaluation accepted when the recommended option set and cost impact are documented.
generic.Evidence location: Benefits program evaluation workbook in the HRIS/Power BI workspace.

steps.title: Compile the full candidate program option list for evaluation
sop: List every candidate program option under consideration.
Confirm the list matches the current plan year's program lineup plus any new options.
Share the list with the Compensation & Benefits Manager and HR Specialist.
Done when the full candidate list is confirmed by all reviewers.
verify: Compare the list to the prior year's program lineup for completeness.
Pass when no active program line is missing from the candidate list.

steps.title: Score each program option against the budget target in Power BI
sop: Pull the budget target for each program line from the Power BI Benefits Cost dashboard.
Score each option (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, EAP, FSA/HSA) against the target.
Record the score in the evaluation workbook.
Done when every candidate option has a budget score recorded.
verify: Recheck two option scores against the budget target.
Pass when the recorded scores match the recalculated budget comparison.

steps.title: Assess each option against employee needs data from the annual benefits survey in HRIS
sop: Pull the annual benefits needs survey results from HRIS.
Match each program option to the relevant survey question results.
Record the employee-needs rating for each option.
Done when every option has a needs rating recorded.
verify: Spot-check one option's rating against the raw survey data.
Pass when the rating reflects the raw survey result.

steps.title: Confirm no option creates disparate coverage tiers between officer and non-officer classes
sop: Review each option's eligibility structure by employee class.
Confirm officer and non-officer classes receive equivalent coverage tiers.
Flag and resolve any option creating a disparate tier.
Done when every option is confirmed free of disparate tiers or the issue is resolved.
verify: Review the eligibility structure for two flagged options.
Pass when no option remains with an unresolved disparate tier.

steps.title: Document the recommended option set with cost impact per option
sop: Select the recommended option set from the scored options.
Record the cost impact for each recommended option.
Save the documented recommendation to the evaluation workbook.
Done when the recommended set and cost impact are documented.
verify: Sum the cost impact of the recommended set against the budget target.
Pass when the summed cost impact is within the approved budget target.

steps.title: Review the documented evaluation with the Compensation & Benefits Manager
sop: Review the scored options and recommended set with the Benefits Administrator.
Confirm the recommendation is ready to proceed to the strategy review.
Note any option requiring further analysis.
Done when the evaluation is approved for the strategy review.
verify: Confirm sign-off is recorded on the evaluation workbook.
Pass when the Compensation & Benefits Manager sign-off is dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every carrier services agreement due for execution for the new plan year.
generic.In-scope period: Contract execution window ending before the plan year effective date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Signer name, signature date, and contract effective date populated on each agreement.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Executed contract count matches the number of contracted carriers.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Executed contracts filed in SharePoint with the execution date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any agreement not returned by deadline logged with a follow-up date.
generic.Test population: Sample every carrier services agreement routed for signature.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when 100% of routed agreements are fully executed.
generic.Exception handling path: Unsigned agreements past deadline escalate to the Compensation & Benefits Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Contract accepted when all signature blocks are complete and dates align.
generic.Evidence location: Vendor Contracts folder in SharePoint and the vendor contract tracker.

steps.title: Confirm the negotiated terms are final before routing for signature
sop: Review the negotiated terms against the approved plan design and rates.
Confirm no open items remain from the negotiation.
Authorize the Benefits Administrator to route the agreement for signature.
Done when the final terms are authorized for signature routing.
verify: Confirm the authorization is logged before routing begins.
Pass when the authorization is dated and recorded.

steps.title: Route the final carrier services agreement for signature through DocuSign
sop: Upload the final negotiated carrier services agreement to DocuSign.
Add the required signer fields for company and carrier signers.
Send the envelope to all required signers.
Done when the DocuSign envelope is sent for every carrier agreement.
verify: Check the DocuSign dashboard for sent status on each envelope.
Pass when every carrier agreement shows a sent envelope.

steps.title: Confirm signature blocks match the authorized company signer of record
sop: Review the signer field configuration in each DocuSign envelope.
Confirm the assigned signer matches the authorized signer of record.
Correct any mismatched signer field before signature.
Done when every envelope routes to the correct authorized signer.
verify: Cross-check the signer list against the corporate signer-of-record list.
Pass when every envelope signer matches the authorized list.

steps.title: Verify contract effective date aligns with the plan year start date
sop: Open each agreement's effective date field.
Compare the effective date to the plan year start date.
Correct any misaligned effective date before final signature.
Done when every agreement's effective date matches the plan year start.
verify: Check the effective date field on two signed contracts.
Pass when the dates match the plan year start.

steps.title: File the fully executed contract in the Vendor Contracts folder in SharePoint
sop: Download the fully executed contract from DocuSign.
Upload the contract to the Vendor Contracts folder in SharePoint.
Name the file with carrier name and plan year.
Done when every executed contract is filed in the folder.
verify: Open the folder and count filed contracts against the contracted carrier count.
Pass when a filed contract exists for every contracted carrier.

steps.title: Update the vendor contract tracker with renewal and next review date
sop: Open the vendor contract tracker.
Enter the renewal date and next review date for each executed contract.
Confirm the tracker reflects the current contract status.
Done when every contract row shows a renewal and review date.
verify: Review the tracker for any blank renewal or review date.
Pass when no contract row is missing a renewal or review date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every qualifying life event case submitted during the plan year.
generic.In-scope period: 30-day IRS Section 125 election window from the qualifying event date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Event type, event date, and supporting document populated on each case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Processed case count matches the logged life event case count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Supporting documents attached to the case record with submission date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases outside the 30-day window logged with the denial reason.
generic.Test population: Sample every life event case processed in the period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every processed case has a document attached and correct effective date.
generic.Exception handling path: Late or undocumented requests route to the employee for correction or are denied.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case accepted when the election change is effective-dated to the qualifying event.
generic.Evidence location: Life Event case record in HRIS.

steps.title: Receive and route the reported life event to the case queue in HRIS
sop: Receive the employee's reported life event via the benefits help desk or portal.
Confirm the employee's identity and event date.
Route the request to the Benefits Administrator's Life Event queue.
Done when the request is routed to the case queue.
verify: Check the queue for the newly routed request.
Pass when the request appears in the queue with the correct event date.

steps.title: Log the life event and verify supporting documentation in the HRIS Life Event case
sop: Open a new Life Event case in HRIS for the reported event.
Record the event type (marriage, birth, divorce, loss of coverage) and event date.
Confirm supporting documentation was submitted with the request.
Done when the case is logged with event type, date, and documentation status.
verify: Reopen the case and confirm all required fields are populated.
Pass when event type, date, and documentation status are all recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the election change request falls within the 30-day IRS Section 125 window
sop: Calculate the 30-day window from the event date.
Compare the request submission date to the window.
Mark the case as within window or deny as late.
Done when every case shows a window determination.
verify: Recalculate the window for one borderline case.
Pass when the recorded determination matches the recalculated window.

steps.title: Apply the coverage and deduction change effective the qualifying event date in the benefits platform
sop: Open the employee's coverage record in the benefits platform.
Apply the approved coverage and deduction change.
Set the effective date to the qualifying event date.
Done when the change is applied and effective-dated correctly.
verify: Check the applied effective date against the logged event date.
Pass when the effective date matches the event date.

steps.title: Attach the supporting document to the case record in HRIS
sop: Scan or receive the supporting document (marriage certificate, birth certificate, COBRA loss letter).
Upload the document to the Life Event case record.
Confirm the document is legible and matches the stated event.
Done when the supporting document is attached to the case.
verify: Open the case and confirm the attached document is legible.
Pass when the document matches the stated event type.

steps.title: Close the case and notify the employee of the completed change
sop: Confirm the coverage and deduction change is reflected in the benefits platform.
Notify the employee that the election change is complete.
Close the Life Event case with the final status.
Done when the case is closed with the employee notified.
verify: Reopen the closed case and confirm the final status and notification note.
Pass when the case shows closed status and a notification record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every benefits plan cost center tracked in the general ledger.
generic.In-scope period: Current fiscal year run-rate through the latest closed accounting period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Actual spend, budget amount, and variance percent populated for every plan.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Plan count in the spend model matches the general ledger cost center count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Spend model published to Power BI with a refresh date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Plans over 5% of budget logged for the strategy review.
generic.Test population: Sample every plan cost center included in the spend model.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every plan shows a computed variance and over-budget flags are complete.
generic.Exception handling path: Over-budget plans route to the annual strategy review for redesign consideration.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Model accepted when it is published and reconciled to the general ledger.
generic.Evidence location: Power BI Benefits Cost dashboard.

steps.title: Confirm the approved annual budget by plan is current before modeling
sop: Retrieve the current approved annual budget by plan.
Confirm no budget revision is pending.
Share the confirmed budget figures with the Benefits Analyst.
Done when the current budget figures are confirmed for modeling.
verify: Compare the shared budget figures to the finance-approved budget document.
Pass when the figures match the approved budget document.

steps.title: Pull actual benefits spend by plan from the ERP general ledger cost center
sop: Run the general ledger cost center report for all benefits plan accounts.
Export actual year-to-date spend by plan.
Confirm the export covers the latest closed accounting period.
Done when actual spend by plan is exported from the ERP.
verify: Compare the exported total to the ERP cost center summary.
Pass when the exported total matches the ERP summary.

steps.title: Build the spend model comparing actual run-rate to the approved annual budget
sop: Load actual spend into the spend model template.
Load the approved annual budget by plan.
Calculate the run-rate versus budget variance for each plan.
Done when every plan shows a calculated variance.
verify: Recalculate the variance for two plans manually.
Pass when the recalculated variance matches the model.

steps.title: Flag any plan tracking more than 5% over budget for the strategy review
sop: Review the variance column for each plan.
Flag plans exceeding 5% over budget.
Note the flagged plans for the strategy review agenda.
Done when every plan over 5% is flagged.
verify: Recheck the threshold calculation for each flagged plan.
Pass when every flagged plan exceeds the 5% threshold.

steps.title: Publish the spend model to the Power BI Benefits Cost dashboard
sop: Load the finalized spend model into the Power BI dashboard.
Confirm the dashboard reflects the current refresh date.
Publish the dashboard for the Compensation & Benefits Manager.
Done when the dashboard is published with the current model.
verify: Open the published dashboard and confirm figures match the model.
Pass when the dashboard matches the finalized spend model.

steps.title: Review the published spend model with the Compensation & Benefits Manager
sop: Review the published dashboard and flagged over-budget plans.
Confirm the model is ready to inform the strategy review.
Note any plan requiring further investigation.
Done when the model is reviewed and accepted.
verify: Confirm review sign-off is recorded on the dashboard notes.
Pass when the sign-off is dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every incumbent carrier in active renewal negotiation.
generic.In-scope period: Renewal negotiation window between RFP results and final rate agreement.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Counter-offer, final rate, and guarantee period populated per carrier.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Negotiation tracker row count matches the incumbent carrier count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Negotiation tracker and correspondence filed in SharePoint with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Carriers not reaching agreement logged with the escalation path.
generic.Test population: Sample every incumbent carrier in the negotiation tracker.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when every carrier shows a final negotiated rate and guarantee period.
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved negotiations escalate to the CHRO/CFO review.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Negotiation accepted when the outcome and savings are documented per carrier.
generic.Evidence location: Renewal negotiation tracker in SharePoint.

steps.title: Confirm the RFP results and benchmarking package are finalized before negotiation
sop: Retrieve the finalized RFP comparison and benchmarking workbook.
Confirm the package is approved for use in negotiation.
Share the package with the Compensation & Benefits Manager.
Done when the negotiation package is confirmed ready.
verify: Check the package version against the approved benchmarking workbook.
Pass when the version matches the approved workbook.

steps.title: Present the benchmarking and RFP results to each incumbent carrier
sop: Prepare the benchmarking and RFP comparison summary for each carrier.
Present the summary to the carrier's account manager as negotiation leverage.
Note the carrier's initial reaction and any concessions offered.
Done when the summary has been presented to every incumbent carrier.
verify: Confirm a presentation record exists for every incumbent carrier.
Pass when every carrier shows a logged presentation.

steps.title: Record each carrier's counter-offer on the renewal negotiation tracker
sop: Open the renewal negotiation tracker in SharePoint.
Enter each carrier's counter-offer rate and terms.
Note the date the counter-offer was received.
Done when every carrier's counter-offer is logged.
verify: Compare tracker entries to the carrier's counter-offer correspondence.
Pass when logged counter-offers match the correspondence.

steps.title: Confirm final negotiated rate guarantee period and rate cap language
sop: Review the final terms offered by each carrier.
Confirm the rate guarantee period and any rate cap language.
Request clarification on any ambiguous term.
Done when guarantee period and rate cap terms are confirmed for every carrier.
verify: Re-read the final terms for two carriers against the tracker entry.
Pass when the tracker entry matches the confirmed final terms.

steps.title: Document the negotiated outcome and savings versus the initial renewal exhibit
sop: Compare the final negotiated rate to the initial renewal exhibit rate.
Calculate the savings achieved per carrier.
Record the outcome and savings in the negotiation tracker.
Done when every carrier shows a documented outcome and savings figure.
verify: Recalculate the savings for one carrier from the tracker inputs.
Pass when the recalculated savings matches the recorded figure.

steps.title: Close out the negotiation tracker with signed-off final terms per carrier
sop: Review the completed tracker for every incumbent carrier.
Confirm no carrier is missing a final rate or guarantee period.
Sign off the tracker as ready for the renewal recommendation.
Done when the tracker is signed off complete for every carrier.
verify: Review the tracker sign-off field.
Pass when the sign-off is present and dated.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the finalized plan year design and contribution rate summary for all plans.
generic.In-scope period: Approval window ahead of the HCM configuration deadline.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: CHRO signature, CFO signature, and approval date populated on the summary.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Approved rate lines match the number of plan options in the summary.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Signed approval filed in the governance folder with the approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any rejected or revised rate line logged with the resolution.
generic.Test population: Sample every plan option in the approved rate summary.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when both CHRO and CFO signatures are recorded on the summary.
generic.Exception handling path: Missing or rejected signatures route back to the Compensation & Benefits Manager for revision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval accepted when signatures are complete and rates match the HCM configuration plan.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deadline date, reminder date, and closure status populated on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reminder-sent count matches the count of cases reaching day 10 without receipt.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deadline, reminder, and closure dates saved on the leave case record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases passing the deadline without receipt logged with the escalation outcome.
generic.Test population: Sample every case tracked against the 15-day deadline.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the day-10 reminder is sent for every case not yet returning a certification.
generic.Exception handling path: Cases past the 15-day deadline escalate to the clarification/second-opinion task.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tracking accepted when the deadline flag is closed upon receipt of a sufficient certification.
generic.Evidence location: Leave case record in HRIS.

steps.title: Confirm the certification form has been sent before starting deadline tracking
sop: Confirm the medical certification form-sent task is complete.
Retrieve the form-sent date for the case.
Proceed to deadline tracking once the form-sent date is confirmed.
Done when the form-sent date is confirmed before tracking begins.
verify: Check the case for the logged form-sent date.
Pass when the form-sent date is present.

steps.title: Set the 15-calendar-day return deadline on the case when the form is issued
sop: Confirm the certification form-sent date on the case.
Calculate and set the 15-calendar-day return deadline.
Confirm the deadline is visible on the case record.
Done when the 15-day deadline is set on the case.
verify: Recheck the set deadline against the form-sent date plus 15 days.
Pass when the deadline calculation is correct.

steps.title: Send a reminder if the certification has not been received by day 10
sop: Monitor cases approaching day 10 without a received certification.
Send the reminder communication to the employee at day 10.
Log the reminder send date on the case.
Done when every case reaching day 10 without receipt has a logged reminder.
verify: Check the case for the day-10 reminder log entry.
Pass when the reminder entry is present and dated at day 10.

steps.title: Escalate to the clarification/second-opinion task if the deadline passes without receipt
sop: Monitor cases reaching the 15-day deadline without receipt.
Escalate each to the clarification/second-opinion process.
Log the escalation on the case.
Done when every deadline-passed case shows a logged escalation.
verify: Check the case for the escalation log entry past the deadline.
Pass when the escalation entry is present for every deadline-passed case.

steps.title: Close the deadline flag once a sufficient certification is received
sop: Confirm a sufficient certification has been received for the case.
Close the deadline tracking flag.
Log the closure date on the case.
Done when the deadline flag is closed upon sufficient receipt.
verify: Recheck the case for the closure entry and date.
Pass when the closure entry is present with a valid date.

steps.title: Confirm no case remains untracked past its 15-day deadline without action
sop: Review all cases with an active 15-day deadline.
Confirm each case shows a reminder, escalation, or closure action as appropriate.
Correct any case missing the appropriate action.
Done when every case shows the appropriate deadline action.
verify: Review the tracker for cases missing an expected action.
Pass when no case is missing its expected deadline action.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is every intake leave request requiring an eligibility determination.

Close the remittance cycle as complete.
Done when the remittance cycle is closed.
verify: Check the cycle status for closed.
Pass when the status shows closed with confirmation on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the Form 5500 annual report and schedules for each retirement plan.
generic.In-scope period: Annual filing cycle through the DOL's statutory deadline or approved extension.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Filing record shows finalized Form 5500, schedules, and auditor's report where required.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Filed schedule count matches schedules required for the plan's filing type.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: EFAST2 acceptance confirmation archived with the plan year and filing date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Filing rejections logged with the correction and resubmission date.
generic.Test population: Sample the Form 5500 filing for each plan year submitted.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass when the EFAST2 acceptance confirmation is archived for the plan year.
generic.Exception handling path: Rejected filings route to the TPA or actuary for correction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Filing accepted when the acceptance confirmation matches the plan year.
generic.Evidence location: Plan governance folder in SharePoint.

steps.title: Confirm the plan's Form 5500 and required schedules are finalized with the TPA or actuary
sop: Review the draft Form 5500 and schedules with the TPA or actuary.
Confirm all required schedules are complete and finalized.
Done when the Form 5500 and schedules are confirmed finalized.
verify: Recheck the finalized filing against the required schedule list.
Pass when no required schedule is missing.

steps.title: Verify the independent auditor's report is attached where the plan requires an audit
sop: Check whether the plan meets the audit requirement threshold.
Confirm the auditor's report is attached if required.
Done when the auditor's report attachment is confirmed as required.
verify: Recheck the filing package for the auditor's report where required.
Pass when the report is present for plans requiring an audit.

steps.title: File electronically through the DOL's EFAST2 system by the deadline or extension
sop: Log into the EFAST2 system with the plan's filing credentials.
Submit the finalized Form 5500 and schedules by the deadline.
Done when the filing is submitted through EFAST2 by the deadline.
verify: Check the EFAST2 system for the submission timestamp.
Pass when the timestamp is on or before the deadline or extension.

steps.title: Confirm the EFAST2 filing acceptance confirmation is received
sop: Check the EFAST2 system for the acceptance confirmation.
Confirm the filing was accepted, not rejected.
Done when the acceptance confirmation is received and confirmed.
verify: Recheck the EFAST2 status for accepted, not rejected.
Pass when the status shows accepted.

steps.title: Archive the EFAST2 acceptance confirmation for the plan year filing
sop: Download the EFAST2 acceptance confirmation document.
Upload it to the plan governance folder in SharePoint.
Done when the confirmation is archived in the governance folder.
verify: Open the governance folder and confirm the archived document.
Pass when the document matches the plan year filing.

steps.title: Sign off the completed Form 5500 filing for the plan year
sop: Review the filed Form 5500 and archived confirmation.
Sign off the filing as complete for the plan year.
Done when the plan year filing is signed off as complete.
verify: Check the governance folder for the signed-off record.
Pass when the record shows a signature and date.
